summary.text: Ryan Rhatigan is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Kyle Brown.
His campaign website lists his profession as residential contractor.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Rhatigan's campaign website says he has lived in Boulder County for the last ten years and works as a residential contractor.
It says he is running on a platform of bringing contractor-style accountability to state spending, and of policies that give Coloradans more control over their education, energy and resources.
